property_summary: Once Initialized() has been called making intitalized=true, SetLogFile(address) must revert (i.e., cannot change Log) for all inputs in the reference; the mutant that removes the revert allows SetLogFile to succeed and change Log after initialization for some input.
change_summary: Removed the guard that prevents setting Log after initialization by deleting the revert check, allowing SetLogFile to update Log even when intitalized is true.
